hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v stupid-comments >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; grep -qiE "^#{1,6}[[:space:]]*comments?[[:space:]]+polic(y|ies)[[:space:]]*$" "$HOME/.claude/CLAUDE.md" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; echo "stupid-comments: a comment policy was found but the binary is not installed, so nothing is being enforced."; echo "  install: cargo install --git https://github.com/nmindz/stupid-comments stupid-comments"; echo "  disable: /plugin uninstall stupid-comments@stupid-comments"'
sh -c 'command -v stupid-comments >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec stupid-comments hook claude || exit 0'
